meta.title: Tier 1–5 Encounter Operational Toolkit
meta.status: director-ops draft — EV/threat budgets; not an XP economy
sources: docs/manuals/The_Directors_Crucible_Complete_Director_Edition.docx (Ch 15 EV, Ch 16 eight-actor, Ch 29 workflow, Part VII Ashen Bell, Part IX T1–5 ops)
meta.xpStance: XP award rules remain BLOCKED (thresholds exist; CR→XP / encounter XP budgets are not canon). This toolkit uses bible EV / incoming-pressure bands and the eight-actor rule only. Do not invent a second XP economy.

tierFloorMap.gate: Vaskor's Seal / Floor 10 (Warded Gate at Floor 3 ends automaton patrol, not the seal)
Canticle Gate (end Floor 50); Bar of Last Refuge = soft cultural quit ≠ Horn

budgetGuidance.method: Combat as Expected Value (Director bible Ch 15)

formulas.hitAssumption: Assume ~2/3 of foe attacks/saves land unless accuracy or defenses say otherwise (Ch 29)

pressureBands.directorReading: Use only if it teaches, reveals, or spends a meaningful non-HP resource
Win with visible cost if engaged honestly
Poor opening / failed objective can drop characters; retreat must remain possible
Telegraph clearly; terrain, prep, or objective leverage required
Only if party knowingly chose risk, has exits, or fight is not meant to be won by damage alone

budgetGuidance.rolePressure: Add one pressure step if two or more apply without a known counter: reliable stun/paralysis, forced movement into severe hazards, flight vs melee-heavy party, invisibility without detection, meaningful foe healing, protected independent objective. Remove one step for surprise, strong chokepoint, researched vulnerability, or participating allies.

eightActorRule.waves: Prepare total opposition; reveal only perceptible actors first. Later waves need a visible trigger. Never add waves solely because the first group died quickly.

budgetGuidance.expeditionSeatNote: Full Expedition max 12 (RAW). Detailed combat usually runs the Combat team (~4) plus a few allies/foes under the eight-actor cap; other seats resolve via clocks/checks.

suggestedDetailedActorCountsByJob.Choosing: 2–5 foes or split fronts via off-map objective
suggestedDetailedActorCountsByJob.ClimacticSeal: Guardian + 0–2 arena features as detailed actors; extra pressure via plates/phases/waves under eight-actor

tierThreatNotes.notes: First fights teach weight/echo/claim. Hard reserved for ignored hazards or split parties. Seal = Hard→Severe with Recognition leverage.
Contamination and living routes raise non-HP tax. Hard when masks fail or Heartroot contested.
Industrial timing can add a free pressure step if players ignore stated cycles.
Exposure + reflection; shade/sun-shields are consumable Resource budget.
Accumulated wear + sound discipline. Catastrophic only for knowingly pressing Canticle without exits.

bestiaryCaveat: Trash/zone fauna in bestiary_data_full.json often has sandbox Type/CR/zoneFound mismatches. Rosters prefer lore-scrubbed names that exist post BESTIARY_LORE_PASS and state intendedCrBand for EV planning. When excel CR is absurd, use bible Ch 17 reskin from a same-band template. Never use SWTOR names. Prefer Umbrin over any residual Drow labels.
